blocks.text: A cultural detail that clarifies the passage is this: Repetition was mnemonic and pedagogical in the ancient world; biblical repetition also signals theological significance.

A cultural detail that clarifies the passage is this: Story-based moral instruction was familiar in the ancient world, but Jesus uses parables to announce God's reign.

Historically, this chapter is read within the following setting: Oral and liturgical cultures rely on repetition, and Scripture uses that habit to form covenant memory.
